label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) is TP: Math.random() generates unpredictable entropy used directly for rememberMeKey written to HTTP response and session attribute. Alert 2 (xss) is TP: User-supplied cookie value flows through URL decoding and concatenation into response writer without HTML escaping.

evidence.note: Math.random() seeded insecurely; value converted to String and trimmed to create rememberMeKey
Response prints user and rememberMeKey derived from user cookie without sanitization
